sentences.text: Un día Sol salió de la casa y no volvió.
sentences.english: One day Sol went out of the house and did not come back.

sentences.text: Luis lo buscó en el jardín y en la calle.
sentences.english: Luis looked for him in the garden and in the street.

sentences.text: Luis estaba muy triste y lloraba.
sentences.english: Luis was very sad and was crying.

sentences.text: —No llores, Luis, vamos a buscarlo —dijo Marta.
sentences.english: "Don't cry, Luis, let's go and look for him," said Marta.

sentences.text: Los dos niños salieron a la calle.
sentences.english: The two children went out into the street.

sentences.text: —¿Vieron ustedes un perro blanco que se llama Sol?
sentences.english: "Did you see a white dog called Sol?"

sentences.text: Un señor dijo: —Sí, lo vi hace un rato, cuando iba hacia el parque.
sentences.english: A man said, "Yes, I saw him a little while ago, when he was going toward the park."
The children ran to the park.

sentences.text: Sol estaba debajo del árbol grande.
sentences.english: Sol was under the big tree.

sentences.text: Cuando vio a Luis, corrió hacia él.
sentences.english: When he saw Luis, he ran toward him.
"Sol, you gave me such a scare!" said Luis.

sentences.text: Desde ese día, Luis siempre cierra la puerta.
sentences.english: Since that day, Luis always closes the door.
